shared_elements: repeated parallel line elements arranged in rows or bands
abstract schematic signs on a flat surface
justification: Both surfaces carry incised, schematic linear signs including circular/disc forms and repeated stroke patterns arranged in rough registers, but this is about as generic as engraved abstraction gets. A depicts a three-dimensional anthropomorphic figure with a head, shoulders and a body bearing concentric discs and curved bands, whereas B is a flat surface covered with straight-line lattices, cross-hatched diamonds and rows of upright stroke-signs with no figural content at all.
